incidents.desc: The #27 car gets door to door with the #99 Car and gets loose.  The #27 car fails to regain control gets sideways on the track and multiple cars are collected
incidents.ruling: Racing Incident.  However it's noted that the #27 car is getting on the mic during the incident which may have contributed to the #27 car not regaining control of his car.  It's recommended to focus on correcting your car before you get on the mic.

incidents.desc: The #4 car moves down and clips the #20 car's rear end.  #57, #13, and #33 are collected in secondary incidents.
incidents.ruling: Racing incident, #4 is at fault however from the cockpit view it does not look intentional.

incidents.desc: The #28 is on the inside lane and abruptly moves into the middle lane turning the #13
incidents.ruling: #28 Car is at fault, please ensure to look / listen to your spotter.

incidents.desc: The #69 Car checks up to avoid the #08 Car, the #69 car looses control and comes down into the #03 car.
The #39 car gets loose and comes down into the #69, the #20 and #13 cars  are collected.

Cars #17 and #30 are racing close taking air off one another, and both getting loose.  Car #17 gets loose under the track and comes up taking the air off the #30 causing him to get sideways and move up the track.  The #29 car and #19 cars are collected.
incidents.ruling: Racing incident however it's important to note track conditions and understanding when you do and don't have grip.

incidents.desc: The number #2 car is pushing the #57, the #57 car gets loose and comes up the track.
incidents.ruling: Race incident, There was a lot of drama/beef leading up to this incident however running through all cars and perspectives it looks like a genuine race incident that added fuel to the existing contention on the track.  The track was extremely slick and most of the incidents so far seem aero related including this one.
